native_display_revisit.resolution: Same pinned native image rendered at full detail on the one revisit, showing intact lettering and supported figures.
native_display_revisit.reason: Tiny initial native display limited detail inspection.

text.usage720_readability: All ten text entries are readable. Identity reduction leaves more upper-left ground space without shrinking date/time, venue or practical right-bank text.
text.raster_punctuation: Paired colon dots, horizontal range dash and middle dots remain visually distinct; code points are not authenticated from raster.

style.checked_requirement: Graphic architectural illustration with bounded flat colors, consistent oblique depth and connected overhead terrain.
style.observations: Bridge, river and distributed land clearings remain continuous; foliage is less finely stippled but still extensive. Ground and water retain soft tonal modeling, and a scenic perspective remains rather than a clear overhead architectural flat system.
issues: Naturalistic texture/tonal washes still remain across most riverbank and water.

ratio.observation: Permitted native height rounding; no native resizing.

substantive_visual.observation: Large bridge and river connect separate film-screen mat audience and mic-led four-chair conversation in one shared public place.

hangul.observation: Square Hangul proportions, consistent navy heavy strokes and open counters remain readable; required word boundaries are visible.

information_relationship.observation: Identity smaller and more inset than initial; descriptor separated from bridge; lower-center schedule and right practical pockets remain useful horizontal groups.

function_contact.observation: Screen legs rest on ground, projector points toward screen, eight seated mat adults face it. Speaker holds mic with an owned connected arm; four listeners sit on supported chairs. Bridge's piers and deck remain coherent.
limits: Some mat figures have limbs partly occluded by seated backs, with simplified native contours.

local_material_edge_finish.observation: Cleaner foliage blocks and explicit chair shadows appear, but shrubs still contain many leaf tips and the water has broad tonal washes.

located_observations.observation: Title width and height have decreased, with more clear bank around the identity and separate left-aligned lines.
Fewer small grass markings than initial, but extensive shrubs, rock shading and water tone still characterize the scene.
Both event actions and their supporting structures remain identifiable with no added copy.
Admission/capacity and mat/weather lines remain legible against clear ground; capacity ends near the right margin but is not clipped.
Bridge links two adult gatherings; identity and schedule now compete less than in initial.

residuals.observation: Scenic naturalistic foliage and tonal water/ground modeling still exceed the bounded flat architectural direction.
High oblique scene retains a substantial bridge side face and frontal screen, so the intended overhead-site impression is only partial.
